int valuesDocID = leafOutcomeValue.docID();
valuesDocID = leafOutcomeValue.advance(valuesDocID);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the advancement of document values is based on the previous document ID (`valuesDocID`) instead of the current document ID (`doc`). This misalignment can cause incorrect document value retrieval, leading to potential mismatches between the expected and actual document values during query processing.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
valuesDocID = leafOutcomeValue.advance(doc);
```
Reason:
The fix updates the advancement logic to use the current document ID (`doc`) instead of the previous document ID (`valuesDocID`). This ensures that the document values are correctly advanced in alignment with the current processing context, thereby resolving the issue of incorrect document value retrieval.
